name: Asante Empire
notes: Founded per Asante oral tradition under Osei Tutu I and priest Okomfo Anokye, conventionally c. 1701 (Battle of Feyiase against Denkyira); formally annexed as a British Crown colony/protectorate 1 January 1902. Ivor Wilks, Asante in the Nineteenth Century (Cambridge UP, 1975); T.C. McCaskie, State and Society in Pre-Colonial Asante (Cambridge UP, 1995).
